🔥 Project Recap | Above the Dust Vancouver Screening & Discussion with Director Wang Xiaoshuai

We were honoured to support the Vancouver screening and discussion of Above the Dust by Wang Xiaoshuai, a leading figure of China’s Sixth Generation filmmakers.

Above the Dust won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 61st Golden Horse Awards.

JYL Broadcast provided multi-camera production, live directing and switching, and on-site technical support for the event. From equipment setup and signal testing to camera coordination and live switching, our team captured the film presentation and audience discussion in full.

Cinema connects us to memory. Images preserve the moment.

电影连接记忆，影像保存现场。
